acceptanceCriteria: docs/CAPABILITIES.md is an agent-facing catalog covering every `corvint` top-level command listed by `corvint help`, every shipped cmd/* binary, and every corvint-mcp / corvint-docs-mcp / corvint-test-validity-mcp tool profile: what question it answers, when to use it, minimal invocation, output profile, maturity (stable/experimental/internal), abstain/refusal behaviour, and owning spec.
A drift check (make target wired into the existing doc-gates list) fails when a command, binary or MCP tool is added or removed without a catalog row, and is proven to fail on a synthetic omission.

AGENTS.md, docs/AGENT-ROUTES.md, docs/README.md, README.md and the shipped agent skills (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini, OpenCode, Pi) route to the catalog; stale capability claims found while doing so are corrected (absorbs V1-0130, V1-1271, V1-1821).
Owning spec requirements, traceability and a build-log entry are recorded.
body: Owner request 2026-10-20: make sure Corvint's capabilities are properly documented so agents can fully understand what it can do. Today capability knowledge is spread across `corvint help`, 55 cmd binaries, MCP tool profiles, per-host skills, docs/AGENT-ROUTES.md and spec Agent digests; no single agent-facing catalog exists and nothing prevents drift (e.g. V1-1271 Codex skill says non-Go impact unsupported; V1-0130 PORTFOLIO omits verbs).
title: docs: agent-facing capability catalog for every command, binary and MCP tool, with a drift gate
